title: BETA Shield MCP Server Tools
description: Protective shield tools: detecting scam patterns, verifying payee safety, evaluating cooling-off timers, and emergency lockouts.

tools.name: screen_scam_risk
tools.description: Screen voice utterances, SMS quotes, or instructions for senior citizen extortion or fraud (e.g. digital arrest, fake police verification, electricity disconnection threats).

text.description: User speech transcript or incoming message text.

tools.name: verify_payee_trust
tools.description: Check if a requested merchant or UPI ID is on the household's pre-approved whitelist.

tools.name: evaluate_cooling_off
tools.description: Check if an approval request is currently undergoing cooling-off delay and compute remaining seconds.

tools.name: trigger_emergency_freeze
tools.description: Emergency lockdown halting all financial transactions immediately for the household.
